deficiencies.description: The rewrite converts the lecturer's pointing words ('the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus') into a spatial relationship ('lies next to') that the lecturer did not state.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: You can see that the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: The tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus

deficiencies.description: The word 'circumspect' was replaced with 'circumscribed' without a corresponding entry in the term corrections list.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: So you can see again that this is actually circumspect

considerations.sourcePassage: has, if you like, invaded within this tissue
considerations.reason: The phrase 'in a sense' conveys the same meaning as 'if you like' in this context.

considerations.sourcePassage: you wouldn't be sampling all over the body
considerations.reason: 'the whole body would not be sampled' expresses the same meaning using passive voice.
